name: Coconut Donut
description: Soft, pillowy dough dipped in a sweet glaze and rolled in toasted coconut flakes. Light, fragrant and gently crunchy in every bite. Perfect with a hot coffee, or on its own whenever a little treat is calling your name.

name: Chocolate Donut
description: Enjoy our rich chocolate donut: a fluffy ring of freshly fried dough under a smooth, glossy chocolate glaze. Deep, sweet and satisfying in every bite. Made fresh each morning for chocolate lovers of all ages.

name: Strawberry Donut
description: A fluffy ring donut covered in pink strawberry glaze with a bright, fruity finish. Soft, sweet and just a little tangy. Dive into pure happiness, whether it is breakfast, an afternoon snack or a gift for someone special.

name: Matcha Donut
description: Light, airy dough topped with a smooth Japanese matcha glaze and a hint of white chocolate. Earthy, creamy and gently sweet. A calm, refreshing treat for anyone who loves green tea flavours.

name: Americano
description: Classic black coffee brewed fresh from carefully roasted beans. Bold, smooth and clean, with a rich aroma that wakes you up. Enjoy it hot or over ice, on its own or alongside your favourite donut.

name: Caffe Latte
description: Smooth espresso blended with silky steamed milk and finished with a light layer of foam. Creamy, warm and comforting. A gentle, balanced cup that pairs beautifully with something sweet from our donut counter.

name: Mistletoe Romance box
description: Our limited-time festive box, filled with hand-finished donuts in pink, red and white. Sweet, charming and made for sharing. A lovely gift for someone special, or a treat for yourself this holiday season.

name: Christmas Mix Family box
description: Our limited-time festive family box, packed with a cheerful mix of classic glazed, rich chocolate and fun sprinkles. Plenty for everyone around the table. Bring home the joy of the season, one bite at a time.
